Catalog nodes in the ``align`` category (one module per node type).
Drift Correction (``align.drift``) — Rigid drift correction across Timepoints (phase cross-correlation on a reference plane);.
Catalog nodes in the ``analysis`` category (one module per node type).

Accumulate DVC Field (``analysis.accumulate_field``) — Compose a previous-frame DVC increment series into cumulative displacement + strain fields by Lagrangian point-tracking (ported ALDVC build_accumulated_results);.
Boundary Band (``analysis.boundary_band``) — Outward boundary band per label region…
Cluster Points (``analysis.cluster_points``) — Cluster a Point cloud into groups (GaussianMixture / KMeans, BIC model-order sweep over n_clusters ± relax%) → a per-point cluster-id label column;.
DIC (pyALDIC) (``analysis.dic_correlate``) — 2D digital image correlation (pyALDIC: IC-GN + ADMM over an adaptive FE mesh) → a Point displacement field (subset centers, disp µm, optional strain);.

Draw Regions (``analysis.draw_regions``) — Hand-drawn labelled regions, each pinned to the frame (m, t, z) it was drawn on: rectangles, circles, ellipses and closed polygons rasterized to a Label layer plus a Label table, so a drawn patch can be measured, overlaid, or handed to Subtract Background as the sample of what counts as background.
DVC (pyALDVC) (``analysis.dvc_field``) — 3D Augmented-Lagrangian digital volume correlation on a ref/def volume series → a Point field (subset centers with disp µm / strain / qfactor);.
Distance Transform (``analysis.edt``) — Euclidean distance transform of a Voxel mask → a µm distance field (anisotropic in 3D);.
Extract Boundary (``analysis.extract_boundary``) — A label region's outline → boundary Points (2D contours / 3D surface vertices); wraps boundary.extract_boundary.

Filter Labels (``analysis.filter_labels``) — Keep or drop WHOLE labels by thresholding one per-label column (mean_intensity, area, eccentricity, …), with the cut chosen by a histogram method over the label population itself → a new Label instance with the surviving ids unchanged.

Histogram Threshold (``analysis.histogram_threshold``) — Histogram threshold segmentation (2D per-plane) → Voxel mask + Label raster + region table; 4 methods × 4 directions, morphology cleanup (ported v1 kernel).

If / Else (``analysis.if_else``) — Split a structure table's objects into a PASS set and a FAIL set by up to four conditions on its own columns, with the condition palette drawn from what the graph upstream actually measured.
Connected Components (``analysis.label``) — Label a mask into connected regions (2D 4/8-conn vs 3D 6/18/26-conn);.

Measure (``analysis.measure``) — Per-label statistics of the image (mean/max/min/area) via the Voxel→Label bridge, plus optional µm-aware `shape` geometry columns (eccentricity, perimeter, solidity, …) from regionprops; or, on Point members, each detection's µm position and the intensity of the voxel it sits on. Both branches also report each row's absolute stage position (`stage_x_um`/`stage_y_um`/`stage_z_um`), for comparing objects across a multi-position acquisition.
Multi-Otsu (``analysis.multiotsu``) — Multi-level Otsu → a class-index Voxel raster (0..K-1), one binary mask per class, or one mask of chosen classes.

Object Field (``analysis.object_field``) — Gridded Eulerian fields from per-object measurements — density (objects/µm²), mean area, intensity, fold change, velocity/speed (µm/s), divergence and curl (1/s) — as a Point layer on a grid_step…

Object Metrics (``analysis.object_metrics``) — Per-object derived metrics onto the member layer: velocity/speed (µm/s), K-nearest-neighbour distances (µm), local divergence/curl (1/s), and frame- or self-normalized intensity fold change.
Optical Flow (``analysis.optical_flow``) — dense per-pixel 2D motion (skimage TV-L1 / iterative Lucas-Kanade) → Voxel displacement layers ``<name>_y``/``<name>_x``/``<name>_mag`` in µm;.

PIV (OpenPIV) (``analysis.piv``) — 2D particle image velocimetry (multipass FFT cross-correlation with window deformation) → a Point displacement field per frame pair (window centers, disp µm, signal-to-noise);.
Reduce → Scalar (``analysis.reduce_scalar``) — Collapse any attribute layer or structure column to ONE number on the Global domain — object count, mean area, total mask volume.
ROI Mask (``analysis.roi_mask``) — Rasterize a serializable shape list ([y,x] verts, in-order add/cut/invert/clear) → a boolean Voxel ROI mask;.

Segmentation (``analysis.segment``) — THE segmentation node: image → a Voxel label raster + a Label table, with the algorithm as a `method` Mode — threshold+CCL, distance-transform watershed, StarDist (CNN), or CellSAM…

Tessellate (``analysis.tessellate``) — Tessellate a labeled Point cloud (convex/concave/Voronoi boundary) or a Voxel label raster (marching cubes) → a MESH: one closed surface per label, with analytic volume/area/density per element;.

Threshold (``analysis.threshold``) — Binarize to a Voxel mask — fixed, or a histogram method (otsu/li/yen/triangle/mean) whose level is derived over the chosen Scope: per plane (default), per volume, per position's whole series, or…
Local Threshold (``analysis.threshold_local``) — Adaptive local threshold → a Voxel mask (uneven-illumination robust);.

Track Field (``analysis.track_field``) — SerialTrack's post-processing: a tracked object field → per-particle displacement (µm), velocity (µm/s), deformation gradient / strain and optional linear-elastic stress (Pa), as a Point field ready for transform.rasterize_field.

Voronoi Cells (``analysis.voronoi``) — Voronoi tessellation LINKING dots to areas: one cell per seed Point, nearest-seed in µm space, clipped to a Label region (per-region arenas) or a mask → a territory Label raster + table…
Catalog nodes in the ``channel`` category (one module per node type).
Select Channel (``channel.select``) — Subset/reorder the channel axis (metadata follows in lockstep).
Split Channels (``channel.split``) — Fan a multi-channel Dataset out into per-channel outputs (each a single-channel Dataset);.
Catalog nodes in the ``detect`` category (one module per node type).
Particle Detection (``detect.particles``) — Particle/small-object detection → Points…
Spot Detection (``detect.spots``) — LoG/DoG spot detection → Points (bright or dark polarity);.
Catalog nodes in the ``enhance`` category (one module per node type).
Bilateral Denoise (``enhance.bilateral``) — Edge-preserving bilateral denoise — stack-of-2D even in 3D mode (skimage denoise_bilateral is 2D-only, H15).
CLAHE (``enhance.clahe``) — Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization; 2D per-plane vs 3D.
Deconvolve (``enhance.deconvolve``) — Richardson–Lucy deconvolution with a PSF derived from optics metadata (NA, emission λ, pixel/z size); 2D lateral PSF vs 3D anisotropic PSF.
Difference of Gaussians (``enhance.dog``) — Band-pass (blob) enhancement; low σ derives from the diffraction limit; high σ 0 ⇒ auto 1.6× low.

Flatten Illumination (``enhance.flatten_field``) — Flatten uneven illumination by removing a large-σ Gaussian background: subtract / subtract+mean / divide+mean / ratio, estimated per plane or averaged over T.

Gamma (``enhance.gamma``) — Power-law γ over a declared intensity scale: `full_range` uses 2**bit_depth-1 (a fixed transfer curve — Cell-Tracker's behaviour, with the significant sensor depth in place of the dtype width),…
Gaussian Blur (``enhance.gaussian``) — Gaussian blur with a metadata-intelligent σ (µm);.
Median (``enhance.median``) — Edge-preserving median filter;.
Morphological Gradient (``enhance.morphological_gradient``) — Dilation − erosion edge map; 2D per-plane vs anisotropic 3D.
Morphology (``enhance.morphology``) — Grayscale morphology (erode/dilate/open/close);.
Non-Local Means (``enhance.nlm``) — Non-local-means denoise — genuinely volumetric in 3D (denoise_nl_means is true n-D).

Normalize (``enhance.normalize``) — Rescale to [0,1] from percentile bounds (scope plane/volume/series) or from an ABSOLUTE intensity window; the statistics scope is a Mode, not the 2D/3D lever (H24).
Remove Blobs (``enhance.remove_blobs``) — Detect bright round artifacts (dust, debris, hot pixels) with LoG/DoG and paint them out — zero / ring-mean interpolate / local median.

Subtract Background (``enhance.subtract_background``) — Estimate a background surface with any of nine popular estimators (Sternberg rolling ball, tunable ellipsoid, morphological opening, minimum / median / percentile box, large-sigma Gaussian, least-squares polynomial surface, whole-unit percentile) and remove it: subtract / signed subtract / divide, for a dark or a light background, or output the estimate itself.

Temporal Gain (``enhance.temporal_gain``) — Correct intensity drift along T by a per-frame gain: reference series_mean (Cell-Tracker Bleach Correction) / rolling_mean (its Temporal Fold Correction) / exponential_fit…
Top-Hat (``enhance.tophat``) — White/black top-hat (flatten background / pop dark features);.
TV Denoise (``enhance.tv_denoise``) — Total-variation (Chambolle) edge-preserving denoise — genuinely 3D in 3D mode (denoise_tv_chambolle is true n-D).
Unsharp Mask (``enhance.unsharp``) — Unsharp-mask sharpening (blur radius in µm);.
Wavelet Denoise (``enhance.wavelet_denoise``) — Wavelet (BayesShrink) denoise — stack-of-2D even in 3D mode (skimage denoise_wavelet is 2D-only);.

ZS-DeconvNet (``enhance.zs_deconvnet``) — self-supervised denoising + deconvolution: a two-stage CNN trained on the incoming data ITSELF (no ground truth), or a published checkpoint run in inference only; 2D U-Net per plane vs volumetric 3D RCAN/U-Net.
Catalog nodes in the ``flow`` category (one module per node type).
Search Step (``flow.advance``) — One step of an Iterate node's feedback search…
Iterate (``flow.iterate``) — Run the chain in front of it once per parameter value and keep one result.
Catalog nodes in the ``group`` category (one module per node type).
group.interface (``group.interface``) — Group interface marker (pass-through);.
Catalog nodes in the ``io`` category (one module per node type).
Export Movie (``io.write_movie``) — render the Dataset on the wire to an MP4, a GIF or a numbered image sequence, with the acquisition's own clock burned into the corner.
Export TIFF (``io.write_tiff``) — stream the Dataset on the wire to a TIFF on disk, one plane at a time, carrying the calibration envelope out verbatim as OME-XML.
Catalog nodes in the ``registration`` category (one module per node type).

Align To (``registration.align_to``) — Measure how far this input's stage log sits from a reference's, per field, by phase-correlating their physical overlap — and RECORD the correction rather than applying it to pixels.
Registration (``registration.stabilize``) — Register-once (on a reference channel) / apply-to-all-channels stabilization;.
Reroute (``rr.reroute``) — an identity pass-through used to route wires on the canvas.
Catalog nodes in the ``track`` category (one module per node type).
Track Linking (``track.link``) — Frame-to-frame tracking → a Track membership: label mode links by maximum IoU overlap, point mode by nearest neighbour within max_distance (µm).

Track Objects (``track.objects``) — Frame-to-frame object tracking with five interchangeable linkers (centroid Hungarian / SerialTrack topology PTV / Cell-Tracker topology, fingerprint, mask-overlap IoU) → a Track membership + a…
Catalog nodes in the ``transform`` category (one module per node type).

Grow (``transform.grow_points``) — Seeds grown into regions: each Point becomes a disc (2D) / ellipsoid (3D) of a physical radius, or each Label region is grown from its OWN shape (outward from its border, scaled about its centroid, or replaced by a disc) → a Voxel label raster + its Label table; overlap resolved by union / nearest / merge.
Label → Points (``transform.label_to_points``) — Every label region → one Point at its centre (centroid / guaranteed-inside / intensity-weighted), keeping a `label` column back to the region.
Rasterize Field (``transform.rasterize_field``) — Interpolate a Point vector/scalar field…

Rasterize Mesh (``transform.rasterize_mesh``) — Rasterize a MESH → one filled Voxel Label region per element (interior test inherited from the mesh provenance: convex hull, or faces-based parity so concavity survives) + a per-element Label…

Transform (``transform.rigid``) — Move selected channels' pixels inside a FIXED frame — translate in X/Y (and Z in 3D) and rotate in-plane about the centre — cropping whatever leaves the frame and zero-filling what it vacates.
Transfer Domain (``transform.transfer_domain``) — Move a lattice attribute between domains (reduce coarsens over dropped axes / broadcast refines);.
Transfer Structure (``transform.transfer_structure``) — Move an attribute across the detected-structure spine — Voxel↔Label↔Point↔Track and structure→Frame (15 pairs).
Catalog nodes in the ``util`` category (one module per node type).
Batch (``util.batch``) — stack two or more files on the BATCH axis so one drawn pipeline runs over all of them, independently.
Chain Files (``util.chain``) — lay a set of source FILES onto one axis (Time, Channel, Z or Multipoint), in filename-sequence order.
Crop (``util.crop``) — Crop Y,X (and Z in 3D mode), or keep only chosen M/T/Z frames.
Crop To File (``util.crop_to``) — crop a Dataset to the field ANOTHER file occupies in absolute stage coordinates (its stage XY plus its field-of-view size).
Merge (``util.merge``) — Merge two or more Datasets by growing ONE chosen axis (Channel / Time / Multipoint / Z). Absorbs and retires ``channel.merge``.
Resample (``util.resample``) — Rescale Y,X (and Z in 3D) by a factor;.
Select Batch Member (``util.select_batch``) — narrow a batch to ONE of its files.
Select Group (``util.select_group``) — keep only the positions of one specimen group.
Stack (T→1) (``util.stack``) — Stack the Timepoint axis → one frame (SNR↑) with a robust combiner (mean/median/sigma-clip/trimmed);.

Stitch (M→1) (``util.stitch``) — Stitch the multipoint axis into one mosaic (M→1, Y/X grow): tiles placed from the file's stage log (optionally refined by phase correlation) or on an explicit grid, blended feather/max/mean/overwrite.
Unbatch (``util.unbatch``) — fan a batch back out into one output per file.
Z-Project (``util.zproject``) — Project the Z axis (max/mean/sum/min/median) → a 2D (z==1) Dataset;.
Catalog nodes in the ``view`` category (one module per node type).
Experiment Canvas (``view.canvas``) — One blank field spanning every wired file's fields at their true stage positions: the primary that lets Overlays put files which share no field into one view.

Overlay (``view.overlay``) — Draw a second Dataset inside this one's field, placed by absolute stage position, pixel size and focus — so two files that ran through different graphs line up on the microscope's own coordinates.
